profile.summary: Workforce Development Unit (WDU) is an Oakland-based organization, founded in 2014, that works to expand education and career opportunities for youth and adults who have been left out of traditional pathways. Its services include early childhood, TK-12 and adult education support, higher education guidance, and workforce development such as career readiness workshops and job placement, internship and apprenticeship placements.
